title: Calendar view bar uses the redesign words, with Coming soon on Day, Week, Timeline and calendar sync

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-22: plug the Space calendar redesign into what exists, Coming soon on the rest

detail:
FILED 2026-10-22. THE CONSEQUENCE: the calendar said Grid, List and Workflow while the redesign says Month, Agenda and Board, and the design's Day, Week, Timeline and Google/Apple/Outlook/Notion sync were nowhere, so nobody could tell they were planned. THE FIX: the view bar reads Month, Agenda, Board (same three surfaces, same cookie); a Coming soon line names Day, Week and Timeline for the team; the calendar settings carry a Two-way sync list with the shared mark on each provider; a visitor's heading reads What's happening. Plan: /mnt/project-files/calendar/calendar-redesign-plan-2026-10-22.md.

SUPERSEDED 2026-10-26 by LIVE-1178 (ADR-1876): Day, Week and Timeline are real views now, so the view bar no longer carries the Coming soon mark this row's probe measured. The sync rows are still Coming soon.

verify.evidence: Superseded by LIVE-1178 (2026-10-26). The probe asserted that Day, Week and Timeline carry the Coming soon mark in the view bar; they are built, so the mark is gone from components/spaces/calendar-mode-toggle.tsx on purpose. The Month, Agenda, Board words are unchanged; calendar-sync-soon.tsx keeps its mark until real two-way sync is built (plan phase 12). The probe script stays in the repo.
